import { requirePrivateAccountMessage } from '@src/utils/privateAccountMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 验证指令（邮箱安全相关流程共用）。验证码、待办状态和确认后的账号写入都由 Go 服务端保存。
 */
import { BackendAPIError, confirmBackendEmailVerification, createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

type PendingType = 'bind' | 'change' | 'changeEmail';

const TITLE_MAP: Record<PendingType, string> = {
  bind: '绑定邮箱',
  change: '更换账号',
  changeEmail: '更换邮箱'
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  if (!(await requirePrivateAccountMessage(e))) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const rawText = String(e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const match = rawText.match(/^(?:!|！|\/|#|＃)?验证\s+(\d{6})$/);

  const sendText = (title: string, text: string) => {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(text);
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title, content: md }));
  };

  if (!match) {
    sendText('验证', '验证码格式错误，用法：/验证 6位数字验证码');

    return;
  }

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  let lastMessage = '当前没有待验证的邮箱流程；请先发送 /绑定邮箱、/更换邮箱 或 /更换账号 获取验证码。';

  for (const type of ['bind', 'change', 'changeEmail'] as PendingType[]) {
    try {
      const data = await confirmBackendEmailVerification(bid, type, match[1], request);

      if (type === 'bind') {
        sendText(
          TITLE_MAP[type],
          `验证成功！邮箱绑定完成\n绑定邮箱：【${String(data.email ?? '')
            .split('')
            .join(' ')}】`
        );
      } else if (type === 'change') {
        sendText(TITLE_MAP[type], `账号切换成功：${String(data.fromName ?? '')} → ${String(data.toName ?? '')}`);
      } else {
        sendText(
          TITLE_MAP[type],
          `邮箱更换成功\n旧邮箱：【${String(data.oldEmail ?? '')
            .split('')
            .join(' ')}】\n新邮箱：【${String(data.newEmail ?? '')
            .split('')
            .join(' ')}】`
        );
      }

      return;
    } catch (error) {
      // A missing type may be another pending verification. A real code error
      // belongs to the matching type and must be returned immediately.
      if (error instanceof BackendAPIError && error.code === 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED') {
        lastMessage = error.message;
        continue;
      }
      logger.error('/验证 指令处理失败:', error);
      sendText(TITLE_MAP[type], error instanceof Error ? error.message : '系统错误，请稍后再试或联系运营');

      return;
    }
  }

  sendText('验证', lastMessage);
});
